summary: Pasqal Holding SA, a French neutral-atom quantum computing firm listed on Nasdaq, filed a 6-K attaching a September 28, 2026 press release announcing an evolution of its collaboration with French public authorities. The company terminated its participation in the defense program LSQUARE (PROQCIMA) after completing first-phase technological objectives, and has been invited to submit a civil research and development program for fault-tolerant quantum computing. No securities, stakes, prices, premiums, board recommendations, or advisors are disclosed; this is a routine business update, not a special situation.
